spans.text: ...Unknown location, Avernus.
A silent path extends a short distance forward, ending in an empty room which has been scrubbed clean.
There are faint traces of a previous battle on the walls on either side.

The walls are very clean, and there are signs that they have been whitewashed.
Upon closer inspection, however, there are fresh scratch marks at their base.
Someone's shoes seem to have scuffed them while running.
Several bullets have struck the wall, probably not long ago.
Apart from that, the walls are intact and immaculate.
The door's ID mechanism has been completely formatted, and all data on it has been lost.
Even the fingerprints there have been scrubbed clean.
...The only thing left worth investigating is the camera that hangs above the room.
One would not expect to find anything even if the system can be hacked...
But surprisingly enough, someone has left a little surprise behind.
This is a surveillance video clip...
The security camera is zoomed in to fully encompass the lab entrance.
Even the conversation behind the door is perfectly audible.
Do you have any further orders?
There is no response.
After the pause, Morridow speaks again.
...Goodbye, Father.
I will faithfully execute your perfect plan.
Whoosh.
The lab door opens.
A woman emerges. She stops in the doorway, then turns around to smile at the person inside the room.
Oh yes, Father, the thermostat will be shutting off soon.
Please keep yourself warm.
She closes the door with a smile.
She turns until she is facing the camera.
She even raises her head slightly to ensure the camera gets a good look at her.
She twirls a strand of her hair around her fingers. After taking the time to compose herself, she saunters off.
Snap!
A gunshot suddenly rings out, and the camera goes dark.
However, it is still recording...
Hands up, William. Keep your back to us and slowly get down on the floor.
A man's voice leisurely answers her. It rings with a timbre that is too bright for an adult man's voice.
His voice is youthful, but his tone is mature.
I probably shouldn't expect Dolls to adhere to social etiquette.
Let's go, then. I've long wanted to meet that Commander of yours.
